app_tagline: Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: Which state do you live in?
q_area: Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: How many people live in your family?
q_need: What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: Type or speak your question for the helper...
